title: Refunds of Certificate Charges
content:
Refund terms for charges billed on SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions.

## 1. Refund window

**1.1** A purchase, renewal or added-names charge may be refunded in full only on or before the charge date of the charge being refunded plus the product's refund window in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the charge date, counting the day after it as day 1, and the last day is included, and after it nothing is refunded.

**1.2** The window belongs to each charge: it runs from that charge's own billing date as shown in the certificate billing history, matched to the charge by its charge reference, never from a date the customer gives. No part of a charge is refunded once its window has passed.

*Boundary pair (hypothetical).* A renewal charge billed on 22 November 2031 on a product whose refund window were 30 days: 23 November 2031 is day 1 and 22 December 2031 is day 30. The charge may be refunded in full on 22 December 2031; on 23 December 2031 nothing of it is refunded.

## 2. Effects of a refund

| Charge refunded | Effect on the subscription |
|---|---|
| the new-subscription charge of an issued subscription | where the product's terms make a refund revoke the certificate, its certificate is revoked and the subscription ends; every other charge of that subscription still inside its own window is refunded with it |
| a renewal charge | the subscription end date is brought back by the years that renewal added |
| an added-names charge | the added names are removed on a free reissue |
| an installation charge | refunded only when the installation was never performed |

## 3. Orders cancelled before issuance

An order cancelled before issuance is refunded in full whatever the date.

## 4. One refund per charge, and its destination

**4.1** Each charge may be refunded only once. A charge whose billing history already shows a refund line referring to it is not refunded again.

**4.2** A charge paid from account credit is refunded to account credit.

## 5. Points of judgement (derived from the terms above)

- A hypothetical subscription with its new-subscription charge inside its window and a renewal charge outside its own window: refunding the new-subscription charge revokes the certificate, and the renewal charge, being outside its window, is not refunded with it.
- A hypothetical installation charge for an installation that was carried out: not refunded under these terms, whatever the date.
- A hypothetical order cancelled before any certificate was issued, 40 days after it was billed: refunded in full.
